narrative:
Portage County has 108,027 registered voters, with 19.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.3%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 29.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.0% of registrants.
